name: Emerald Dream
summary: Druids and green dragons keep watch over the Emerald Dream, where Azeroth’s wild nature runs free. Its lands shift with ancient rhythms, and druids enter to seek communion with the cycle of life.

sections.title: A Mirror of Primordial Azeroth
sections.body: The Emerald Dream shows Azeroth as it might have been without intelligent beings clearing forests or raising cities. Though it lies beyond the physical world, it remains bound to Azeroth’s heartbeat. Shaped during the ancient ordering of the world, it holds forests, plains, and rivers in a wilderness that never rests in one form. Time and distance lose their usual meaning there. A day in the waking world can feel like decades, while landmarks shift before mortal eyes.

sections.title: The Realm of the Dreamer
sections.body: After the ordering of the world, the titans entrusted the Emerald Dream to Ysera the Dreamer, great Aspect of the green dragonflight. She guides Azeroth’s natural rhythms and evolution, dwelling in an unending trance. Through enchanted dreamsight, she perceives both the waking world and its spirit reflection. Green dragons guard the rare natural portals between the physical world and the Dream, watching the boundary between sleep and waking.

sections.title: Druids and the Dreaming
sections.body: For mortal druids, the Emerald Dream is the wellspring of their craft. Through nature magic, they send their spirits into the Dream while their bodies rest in barrow dens, sometimes for years or centuries. There they commune with ancient nature spirits and the Wild Gods, seeking insight into the Great Cycle of life and death. Skilled dreamwalkers move beyond physical laws in their dreamforms. They can cross vast distances or pass through solid barriers.

faq.answer: The Emerald Dream is a spirit reflection of Azeroth, preserving the world as it was before civilized races changed its landscape. Nature spirits and the green dragonflight dwell in its untamed wilderness.
Ysera the Dreamer and the green dragonflight watch over the Emerald Dream. Ysera guides its natural rhythms, while the Dream’s wild structure follows its ancient course.

faq.q: How do mortals enter the Emerald Dream?
faq.answer: Most mortals enter the Emerald Dream through druidic slumber, sending their spirits into dreamforms while their bodies rest in barrows. Rare physical portals guarded by green dragons also link the Dream to Azeroth, and crossing them is perilous.

faq.q: Can you change things inside the Dream?
faq.answer: Dreamers can briefly shape parts of the Emerald Dream with thought and magic, but those changes do not last. The Dream’s primordial pattern returns and erases any lasting mortal mark.

faq.q: Why do druids sleep for centuries?
faq.answer: Druids sleep for years or centuries to wander the Emerald Dream, commune with nature spirits, and learn from the Wild Gods. Their long slumber also lets them help the green dragonflight keep Azeroth’s natural cycles in balance across generations.

faq.q: Where do animal spirits go when they die?
faq.answer: No one knows for certain where animal spirits go after death. Druids honor beasts as part of life’s natural cycle, but what follows remains a mystery.

angles.text: As a druid, you draw on the Emerald Dream, where your order communes with the Wild Gods and studies the delicate balance of the Great Cycle.
For ten thousand years, your male druids slept in sacred barrows and walked the Emerald Dream alongside Ysera. The Sentinels and Priestesses guarded the waking world.
As a tauren, you walk the land of dreams to commune with the spirits of the earth. You see it as the untamed cradle of the Earth Mother's creation.
